verdict.rationale: Airweave's search docs give one approximate latency figure: about 0.5 seconds for direct vector search, recommended when speed is critical. This is a single rough target for one search mode, with no percentile breakdown or measurement methodology behind it. missing for 10: p50/p95/p99 measured latency numbers, published benchmark methodology or conditions, latency figures for the agentic search mode, independent or hands-on latency corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see documented retrieval-latency targets or measured numbers (e.g. p50/p95) backing the product's speed claims

citations.quote: Direct vector search. Use when speed is critical (~0.5sec).
